name: Coffee + tea (packets)
equipment: burner + large kettle or pot for hot water
notes: Coffee and tea are single-serve packets: just add hot water. Creamer, sugar and no-sugar sweetener on the side.

steps.text: Heat water in a large kettle or pot. Set out the coffee packets ({coffee_packets}), tea bags, creamer, sugar and sweetener with stir sticks.

serving: Adults serve themselves; hot water stays on the adults' end of the table.
